patches: kicadImportSchematic (pcbjam cc/main 49da806, finished in pcbjam cc/main e790a09)
MAPPED_FILE for the WebAssembly platform (pcbjam cc/main c9752f8)
Altium ReadProperties repair, Header already parsed (kicad cc/main 4f1c8f27, the repair of KiCad master d07e9384)
KIID string-constructor repair, the random fallback outside the catch handler (kicad cc/main 0e0b3f54; the in-handler thread_local access compiled to a trap and every Altium board import died on it)
kicadFootprintSetModels, one footprint's 3D model list replaced by uuid as ONE undo step, a BOARD_COMMIT Modify then Push (pcbjam cc/main 466a85a; the island's footprint.models, the models cap)

kicadPlotBoard, the board's Gerbers and drill files plotted with no KiCad dialog through KiCad's own JOB_EXPORT_PCB_GERBERS and JOB_EXPORT_PCB_DRILL on the apply coroutine (pcbjam cc/main 924d67c; the island's project.plot, the plot cap)

JobExportGerbers render settings repair, each plotted layer's PCB_RENDER_SETTINGS deleted with its plotter as PCB_PLOTTER::Plot does (kicad cc/main e767bb33, pinned by pcbjam cc/main 3798191; every plotted layer leaked one, and the editor's memory never shrinks)

kicadSetChrome holds the hidden chrome: handlers on the frame's wxAuiManager render and size events hide any pane but the canvas, the menu bar and the status bar that come back while it is hidden, before the stale layout draws, and window.kicadChrome.onChange reports each flip of the real state, kicadChromeShown reads it (pcbjam cc/main 27d82c2; a pane toggle such as Ctrl+H, a pane's close button, which rebuilt the menu bar, a save, a load and a theme change had brought KiCad's chrome back over the canvas-only editor)

AUI caption offset repair, Repaint and the pane button hover no longer shift the WASM port's client DC by the client area origin it already starts at (wxwidgets cc/main d235efd; with KiCad's menus shown every pane caption drew one menu bar lower, over the pane's first row)
